cohort: 219 infants born with gastroschisis between 1990 and 2008
finding: Over nearly two decades, delivery of gastroschisis babies shifted from ELCS to sVD, a practice associated with a significantly longer LOS.
mod_finding: Babies born by spontaneous vaginal delivery had longer hospitalization than those born by elective cesarean delivery (median 36.0 vs 21.6 days, p <0.05).
gest_age: Gestational age was similar between groups and was included as a variable in the analysis
birth_weight: Birth weight was similar between groups and was included as a variable in the analysis
